Topics covered in this PDF

MEG-04 (English Language and Linguistics) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Language as a system of communication, the role of the vocal organs in speech, characteristics of human language
  • Historical development of the English language, English phonetics and phonology, language and society

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.
